verdict.rationale: Gazebo is software you install and run on your own machines. First-party docs cover binary installs (the gz-jetty metapackage), a source-based install path, and a lightweight headless server package (gz-sim10-server) for CI and headless use. They also cover running the server with the -s flag and running simulation on remote servers you control via Gazebo Transport, with the core gz-sim source on GitHub. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments, explicit open-source license evidence in the pack.
